description: Teachify MCP tool specs for registries / clients.
name: teachify

tools.description: Start a guided learning task. Returns overview + step 1 only — never the full solution.
tools.name: teach_start_task

tools.description: Return the current step. Never skips ahead.
tools.name: teach_next_step

tools.description: Verify the learner's current step. Pass/fail + targeted feedback. On fail, never reveals next solution.
tools.name: teach_check_step

tools.description: Escalating hints L1-L3. L3 still does not type the code.
tools.name: teach_hint

tools.description: 2-3 quiz questions. answerIndex is for LLM grading only — do not reveal upfront.
tools.name: teach_quiz

tools.description: Progress summary: steps done, time, attempts, hints, mastery notes.
tools.name: teach_progress
